forms.title: Taleo Enterprise career section: Apply Online, login wall with New User registration, 7-step jobapply.ftl wizard
quirks: jobdetail.ftl → a#applyFromDetailBtn 'Apply Online' (next to 'Add to My Job Cart' / 'Send to a Friend')

login wall: form#loginForm (User Name / Password / Login) and the 'New User' link to form#registerForm: User Name, Password, Re-enter Password, Email Address, terms checkbox, Register; password policy; 'User name is not available' when taken
the session lasts for the browser session: every new browser signs in again with the stored account
jobapply.ftl train of steps with JSF ids (et-ef-content-ftf-gp-j_id_id8pc9-page_N-...); 'Save and Continue', 'Save as Draft', 'Quit', 'Previous'
Privacy Agreement acceptance checkbox; resume file input with an attached-files list
Country select reloads the State/Province list after a delay (disabled until then)
questions as selects with 'Select...' placeholders and a radio group; Diversity radios with 'I choose not to disclose'
eSignature full name with a read-only date; Review and Submit lists the answers and shows the only 'Submit' button
forms.reference: Public Taleo career sections (<tenant>.taleo.net/careersection/<n>/jobdetail.ftl, jobapply.ftl), studied read-only
